derivations.method: Off Duty 21:00 read as ORD local (arrival station) on 01/09, since the header states times are local to the station shown; converted to UTC.
Report 20:20 is printed but carries no station; taken as ORD local (the origin of the first sector, where the crew nightstopped) rather than MAD.
STA 13:50 and Off Duty 14:20 are MAD-local on 04/09, one day after the row date; the +1 day is derived from the 9h00 block, not printed.
Report 21:40 taken as JFK local (origin of CR345) on 07/09; the row's flight departs JFK 23:10 local.
Arrival and Off Duty (13:10 / 13:40 MAD local) fall on 08/09, derived from the 23:10 departure plus 8h00 block; the date rollover is not printed.
Sectors 3 and 4 and Off Duty 06:18 fall on 12/09 local; rollover derived from the 23:55 MAD departure and the printed 14h53 duty length.
Off Duty 00:14 is MAD local on 25/09 (after the 23:44 arrival on 24/09); converted to 2026-09-24T22:14Z. Rollover derived, not printed.
